# Agentic Life OS (ALOS)

Publication-candidate local-first agent runtime with private-instance overlays.

## Public boundary

- Public repository: code, contracts, docs, synthetic fixtures, and generic templates.
- Private instance overlay: preferences, local policy identifiers, and sanitized notes; it is not authority.
- Private runtime authority store: authenticated capabilities, consent, approvals, and revocations.
- Encrypted local vault: raw personal, clinical, genomic, family, and financial data.
- Profile assertions: `unverified-declarative-configuration`; fields below are configuration declarations, not runtime receipts.

## Version axes

- Runtime package version: `0.3.0`
- Profile contract version: `1.4.0`
- SIP compatibility version: `1.1.1`
- Discovery asset schema: `1.3.0`
- Runtime target: Portable Node.js 24 target; Windows verified, Linux CI pending

## Health knowledge source

- Repository: `frankxai/health-intelligence-system`
- Required immutable bindings: `pinVersion`, `repository`, `commitSha`, `artifactVersion`, `artifactPath`, `mediaType`, `byteLength`, `sha256`
- Integrity proves exact bytes against the supplied pin. Provenance requires separate private Git and release-manifest verification; neither proves clinical validity.

## Safety contract

- Runtime authority: `private-runtime-authority-store`
- Default admission: `deny`
- Prohibited public data: `raw-health-records`, `clinical-data`, `genomic-data`, `family-records`, `secrets`, `authority-state`, `personal-metrics`
- Prohibited agent actions: `diagnosis`, `treatment`, `medication-change`, `result-interpretation`, `emergency-reassurance`, `autonomous-transport`, `public-storage-of-private-records`
- Family/genetic data classes: `family-records`, `genomic-data`
- Denied generic destinations: `memory`, `creator`
- Controls required before any specialized private flow: `private-encrypted-deployment`, `consent`, `audit`, `backup-restore`, `audience-authorization`, `succession-controls`

## Offering

- Name: Agentic Life OS
- Audience: Builders who want a local-first, bounded agent runtime for life domains.
- Promise: Compose reusable agents without placing personal data or authority in public code.
- Status: `draft`
- Delivery: Planned clean-history public projection with synthetic examples and a private-instance overlay template.
- Public boundary: Publication-candidate code and synthetic data only; live records, secrets, authority, and metrics stay private.

### Public Runtime
- Audience: Developers and researchers
- Promise: Use bounded contracts, tests, and templates under an open-source license.
- Delivery: Self-hosted source code
- Commercial status: `free`
- Support boundary: Community and self-serve; no personal-data processing.

### Private Instance Overlay
- Audience: Individuals and trusted local operators
- Promise: Configure the public runtime without forking personal data into product code.
- Delivery: Generic local-first template
- Commercial status: `free`
- Support boundary: The operator owns storage, consent, clinical decisions, and backups.

## Intelligence systems

### Starlight Intelligence System
- Repository: `Starlight-Intelligence-System`
- Layer: `substrate`
- Declared public status: `hybrid`
- Purpose: Memory, provenance, taxonomy, and validation substrate.
- Proof gate: Keep public and private state separate and attach deterministic evidence.

### Health Intelligence System
- Repository: `health-intelligence-system`
- Layer: `domain-vertical`
- Declared public status: `publication-candidate`
- Purpose: Evidence, protocols, privacy patterns, and clinician-preparation templates.
- Proof gate: Pin artifacts by immutable commit, version, path, length, and SHA-256.

## Estate roles

### agentic-life-os
- Lane: `master-offer`
- Role: Private hardening source for a clean-history public runtime projection and private-instance overlay contract.
- Declared evidence basis: `repo-evidenced`
- Declared status: `primary`

### health-intelligence-system
- Lane: `health`
- Role: Public health evidence and protocol source.
- Declared evidence basis: `repo-evidenced`
- Declared status: `primary`

### Starlight-Intelligence-System
- Lane: `substrate`
- Role: Memory, provenance, and validation substrate.
- Declared evidence basis: `repo-evidenced`
- Declared status: `supporting`

## Operating loops

### Daily Command Loop
- Cadence: daily
- Owner: human-operator
- Purpose: Select one bounded objective, authorize it, execute it, and retain evidence.
- Inputs: private queue, current authority, public runtime
- Outputs: bounded task, decision receipt, handoff
- Safety gate: No external, financial, clinical, destructive, or sensitive-data action without explicit authority.

### Health And Excellence Loop
- Cadence: private daily log plus weekly review
- Owner: human-operator
- Purpose: Organize wellness signals and clinician questions without replacing professional care.
- Inputs: encrypted local vault descriptors, pinned public health artifacts
- Outputs: report-only structured review validation, clinician-question templates, planned private-adapter export controls
- Safety gate: No diagnosis, treatment, medication, result interpretation, or emergency reassurance.
